# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.3

This prerelease makes strict TypeScript the canonical OpenOntology product
source while preserving the installed dependency-free ESM runtime.

## Included

- the same compact `verify`, `search`, `read`, `check`, and `status` product
  vocabulary;
- generated declarations, declaration maps, and source maps;
- a self-contained public SDK declaration contract;
- a bounded `oont/kernel` extension Interface for managed and research
  runtimes;
- installed-package compilation and runtime checks on Node 24 and Node 26;
- unchanged quickstart artifact, source commit, and replay identities.

## Alpha boundary

- This release is for local developer experimentation.
- Automatic production connectors and managed hosting are not included.
- The kernel extension Interface does not expose Admission, review, activation,
  or other private control-plane logic.
- Earlier alpha artifacts must still be rebuilt from Adapter input after an
  incompatible artifact change.

## Verify the download

The release contains the package tarball and `SHA256SUMS`. GitHub also publishes
a provenance attestation for the tarball.

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify oont-0.3.0-alpha.3.tgz \
  --repo Doss-com/openontology
```

See the repository README for installation, quickstart, SDK, CLI, MCP, storage,
and contribution guidance.
